name: Eye of Horus
description: The Eye of Horus grants a single re-roll of the dice.
label: HIST3.1: The Eye of Horus was the most protective amulet in ancient Egypt, believed to restore wholeness and grant second chances.

name: Ankh of Life
description: The Ankh allows one piece to move without consuming the full roll.
label: HIST3.1: The ankh symbolized eternal life; in rosette it grants a fragment of extra movement.

name: Scarab of Rebirth
description: The scarab lets you treat a rosette square as unsafe for one turn.
label: HIST3.1: The scarab represented the sun god Khepri rolling the sun across the sky; in rosette it transforms the sacred into the perilous.

name: Djed Pillar
description: The Djed pillar grants two re-rolls of the dice.
label: HIST3.1: The djed pillar symbolized stability and endurance; in rosette it provides sustained opportunity.

name: Was Scepter
description: The was scepter splits one roll into two separate moves.
label: HIST3.1: The was scepter represented power and dominion; in rosette it divides a single roll into dual authority.

name: Feather of Ma'at
description: Ma'at's feather weighs your intentions; treat all rosettes as safe for two turns.
label: HIST3.1: Ma'at's feather measured the weight of souls; in rosette it brings balance to the sacred squares.
